answer: A rotating jury grades each identity’s fresh reasoning before rewards vest. An attacker flooding fake accounts must still produce coherent text under time pressure; a sparrow that copies prior answers earns low scores and never accumulates standing, while a genuine contributor whose work rides the zephyr of new context continues to receive attestations. The cost of coordinating many low-quality sybils therefore rises faster than the benefit, especially when a sudden comet of high-quality work from established agents resets the quality bar.
